components.css: .ds-dock { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; overflow: hidden; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-bg-surface); color: var(--color-text-primary); text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-dock:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-default); } .ds-dock:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(var(--color-accent-primary-rgb) / 40%); } .ds-dock--active { background: var(--color-bg-overlay); } .ds-dock--active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 2px; background: var(--color-accent-primary); } .ds-dock__icon { display: flex; flex: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-default); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-bg-elevated); color: var(--color-text-secondary); } .ds-dock__copy { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-dock__row { display: flex; min-width: 0; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-dock__title { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-dock__meta { display: block; overflow: hidden; color: var(--color-text-muted); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

narrative.northStar: Airy Glass Workbench (轻盈玻璃工作台)
narrative.overview: A static mint-to-lavender field surrounds one paper-like application sheet with matched light/dark palettes. Only the non-scrolling sheet blurs. Dense reading surfaces, controls, charts and overlays stay solid; existing data, navigation, preference and interaction contracts are preserved.
keyCharacteristics: Static mint-to-lavender field with one paper-like app sheet, matched light and dark palettes.
Green for action/link/focus, explicit output purple, independent semantic status and source identity.
Solid reading surfaces and overlays; opaque fallback below 960px, reduced transparency or no blur support.
Existing font tracks, tabular figures, bounded charts, dense rows and honest empty states.
Preserved theme preference migration, keyboard focus, scroll ownership and native permissions.

rules.name: The Status-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Danger/warning/success/info communicate state with text and icons. Green may also mark action/link/focus; purple only explicit output.

rules.name: The Action Color Rule
rules.body: Use green for action, active route and focus; keep reading surfaces neutral and status semantics independent.

rules.name: The Platform Tick Rule
rules.body: Platform colors identify; they never repaint. Allowed surfaces: 2px ticks, legend swatches, chart segments, identity dots.

rules.name: The Mono Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Use mono for data, code, time and commands; prose remains sans.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: Any number a user compares or watches uses tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums). Columns of digits must not jitter.

rules.name: The Product Type Rule
rules.body: Fixed rem scales inside app surfaces; no viewport-fluid hero type beyond the one display clamp.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Separate with a hairline or a tonal step before reaching for shadow. A resting card casts none.

rules.name: The Glass Budget Rule
rules.body: At most one visible backdrop-filter, on the non-scrolling app sheet only. All reading and overlay roles are solid. Below 960px, reduced transparency or no blur support: alpha=1 and blur=none.

rules.name: The Sheet Geometry Rule
rules.body: 20px only on the application sheet; static wells may use 16px. Keep dense controls and virtual rows at existing geometry.

rules.name: The Two-Pixel Tick Rule
rules.body: Identity and active state arrive as 2px ticks, never as stripes, glows, or filled rails.

dos: Do use green for command, active route, and focus — and keep it under 10% of the screen.
Do preserve status text/icons independently of action green, paired with their contrast ink.
Do set every numeric readout, timestamp, version, and route index in mono with tabular figures.
Do separate surfaces with hairlines and tonal steps before shadows.
Do render honest empties: dashed baselines, — placeholders, muted unindexed metrics — never a fabricated zero.
Do keep charts bounded (clamp(10rem, 26vh, 16rem)) and data rows at fixed heights.
Do subscribe copy through useAppT() and keep the locale contract green.
Do honor data-reduced-motion: micro-interactions collapse to 0ms and lifts flatten.
Do give the Insights weekly chart a secondary encoding: segment gaps, a legend, direct labels at 4 or fewer series, a tooltip per segment, the stripe texture on "其他", and a table view.
Do give the Insights weekly chart and the activity heatmap a chart / table switch; the table view gives exact values for colors below 3:1.
Do keep the top 4 sources and the stack order fixed across the whole weekly chart; color follows the source, not the rank.
Do give every Insights chart a fixed or clamped height, and every Insights table row a fixed height.
Do write a 7-day change as sign plus text (+21.7%, −17.6%, +2 天, 持平, 新增) in secondary ink.
donts: Don't rebuild the metric-card row plus unbounded hero chart — that dashboard cliché is the rejected rut.
Don't repaint panels or chrome in platform colors; identity stays on 2px ticks and swatches.
Don't add decorative glass, nested glass, or glass inside scrolling content.
Don't add nested glass, gradients inside reading surfaces, guofeng, neko or anime variants; the single mint-to-lavender field is approved.
Don't spread the sheet radius onto dense controls, change virtual row geometry or use gradient text.
Don't use fluid hero typography or decorative fonts inside app surfaces.
Don't capture a bare t outside useAppT(), and don't leave zh-CN copy unglobalized.
Don't hide disabled, blocked, or destructive states — they must read at a glance.
Don't color a 7-day change green or red; the change is not a status.
Don't use green or status colors in the heatmap ramp or the distribution bars; they use --color-chart-heat-* only.
Don't add a chart library for Insights; charts are plain DOM and CSS.
Don't build the Insights totals as metric cards or as a copy of the platform quote band; it is one hairline-ruled reading line.
Don't give each of the nine sources its own weekly-chart color; merge everything past the top 4 into "其他".
Don't use platform colors on project or model rows in the leaderboard; only Agent rows carry the platform tick and bar.
